result:
This diff is clean and does exactly what was asked. Summary of the refactor:

- **`src/click/_termui_impl.py`**: replaced the `_has_binary_buffer`/`_BufferedTextPagerStream` type-guard branch in `get_pager_file` with an unconditional path â€” every pager backend now guarantees a text stream with a real `.buffer`, so `MaybeStripAnsi(stream.buffer, ...)` always applies. The one gap (the "no stdout attached" fallback, previously a bare `StringIO()` with no `.buffer`) is now `_binary_backed_stdout()`, backed by a small `_BinaryBackedStdout` class exposing `.buffer`/`.encoding`/`.isatty()` â€” deliberately not a `TextIOWrapper`, since that would auto-close its buffer on GC once nothing else references it (a real bug I hit and fixed while testing). Also dropped the misleading `t.cast(t.BinaryIO, ...)` casts on inherently text-mode streams (`c.stdin`, the tempfile handle) in favor of honest `t.TextIO` types, and simplified all three backends' return-type annotations from `t.BinaryIO | t.TextIO` to plain `t.TextIO`.
- **`tests/test_termui.py`**: updated three tests that had locked in the old branching (bufferless-stream) behavior, and refreshed an outdated docstring referencing the removed `_has_binary_buffer` probe.

Full test suite: 1900 passed, 94 skipped, 1 xfailed â€” no regressions.
